data.body: RP28 approved as maintainer-refined full removal on 2026-09-01; the compatibility-tombstone approach is rejected. Closed epic `pink-complex-xenurine` and child `byzantine-spinelike-penguin` already removed the vestigial `BLOCKING_SEVERITIES` config in main commit 8db373933654c7c21fa214565426f562ca55cd80. A read-only `origin/main` census confirms no live parser/config field remains, but finds stale operational claims in `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md:383` and `src/rebar/review_bot/config.py:4,12`. The Janitor child should remove those live remnants and any equivalent deployment/example references, prove no operational surface remains, and leave four-pass Pass 3 as the sole voting policy. Historical ADRs and archived experiment inputs may retain accurate history; do not duplicate the already-completed code removal.
